content.title: Top-Performing ETF Areas of July

content.summary: WEED, BDRY, and ETHV surged as tariff fears, crypto momentum, and rare earth tensions drove ETF outperformance last week.

content.title: Best-Performing ETF Areas of Last Week
content.summary: Trump's sweeping new tariffs on Canada, the EU, and Mexico weight on markets slightly last week. However, crypto (i.e. ETHV and APED) and cannabis ETFs (i.e. WEED) surged on their own fundamentals.
